node: Travel and hospitality operating systems: property management, booking connectivity, payments, loyalty, and channel management
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the travel/hospitality operating-system node. The best underfollowed lane candidates are Agilysys for hospitality property/POS software, PAR Technology for restaurant POS/loyalty/ordering/payments, Shift4 for hospitality/restaurant/leisure payments infrastructure, and Sabre as a higher-risk booking-connectivity/GDS platform after its 2025 Hospitality Solutions divestiture. Toast, Booking, Expedia, Amadeus, and Oracle Hospitality remain useful reference anchors, but were not prioritized in this pass because the instruction emphasized underfollowed US-listed small/mid-cap exposure. Expanded the node around scarce / sticky travel and hospitality operating-system infrastructure rather than consumer-facing travel platforms. The strongest underfollowed lane candidates are vertical software and embedded-payments vendors where switching friction may come from PMS/POS integrations, payment routing, loyalty/guest-data workflows, multi-location rollouts, channel connectivity, and restaurant/hotel operating processes. This is not a buy/sell list; it is a Layer 1B research universe for later evidence checks. Expanded the underfollowed discovery lane for travel/hospitality operating systems. The cleanest public-market exposures found in this pass are not mega-cap travel platforms, but vertical software and embedded-payment vendors serving hotels, casinos, restaurants, venues, and travel-retail tax/refund workflows. Candidates are research leads only, not investment recommendations. Key verification work for later layers: retention/NRR, paym
